title: Docker Compose setup with PostgreSQL
description: Create a docker-compose.yml at the project root that spins up a PostgreSQL 15 container for local development. Include an .env.example with all required environment variables. The database should be accessible on localhost:5432 with a named volume for data persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: Running 'docker compose up -d' starts a PostgreSQL 15 container
Database is accessible at localhost:5432 with credentials from .env
Named volume ensures data persists across container restarts
A 'docker compose down -v' command removes all data cleanly

steps.details: Create docker-compose.yml at project root with a 'db' service using image postgres:15-alpine. Set POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB from environment variables. Map port 5432:5432. Add a named volume 'pgdata' mounted at /var/lib/postgresql/data. Add a healthcheck using pg_isready.

Create .env.example documenting all variables: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/gitshipdone, POSTGRES_USER=gitshipdone, POSTGRES_PASSWORD=gitshipdone, POSTGRES_DB=gitshipdone, JWT_SECRET=your-jwt-secret, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET=your-refresh-secret, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=, GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=, GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET=, RESEND_API_KEY=, ENCRYPTION_KEY=32-char-key, FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:5173, PORT=3000
Ensure .gitignore includes .env (but not .env.example). Also add node_modules/, dist/, and *.js.map if not already present.
In the root package.json (or server package.json), add: 'db:up': 'docker compose up -d', 'db:down': 'docker compose down', 'db:reset': 'docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d'

Run 'docker compose up -d' and then 'docker compose ps' to confirm the db service is healthy. Connect with psql: psql postgresql://gitshipdone:gitshipdone@localhost:5432/gitshipdone and run \l to list databases.

technicalNotes: Use postgres:15-alpine for a smaller image footprint
The healthcheck prevents dependent services from starting before Postgres is ready
Use a named volume (not bind mount) so data survives 'docker compose down' without -v
